- prompt_ambiguous: the stated facts or the definition genuinely admit more than one answer (for example the answer turns on an input the prompt does not list).

 - Fast mode for Claude Code uses Claude Opus with faster output (it does not downgrade to a smaller model). It can be toggled with /fast.

# Context management
When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

input.summary: Oklahoma expanded Medicaid, so the head, a 21-year-old who is not pregnant, not disabled and not on Medicare, falls in the expansion-adult group. That group uses a MAGI income test with no asset test, and having employer coverage does not bar eligibility. The head's MAGI is $312 of taxable interest. The $50,000 of 'financial assistance' is not a taxable source in IRC 36B MAGI. $312 is far below OHCA's 2026 limit for one person of $22,176 a year (effective 4/1/2026). The engine found MAGI of about $312 (0.02 times FPL) and adult-group eligibility, which matches the law. The consensus value of 0 rests on wrongly counting the $50,000 as income, applying an asset test, or saying Oklahoma did not expand.

citations.source: Oklahoma Health Care Authority, SoonerCare and Insure Oklahoma Income Guidelines - 2026
42 CFR 435.603 (Application of modified adjusted gross income)
citations.quote: the agency must not—(1) Apply any assets or resources test; or (2) Apply any income or expense disregards

citations.source: 42 CFR 435.603 (Application of modified adjusted gross income)
citations.quote: income calculated using the same financial methodologies used to determine modified adjusted gross income as defined in section 36B(d)(2)(B) of the Code

citations.source: 42 CFR 435.119 (Coverage for individuals age 19 or older and under age 65 at or below 133 percent FPL)
citations.quote: Are age 19 or older and under age 65; (2) Are not pregnant; (3) Are not entitled to or enrolled for Medicare benefits under part A or B
all income included in Modified Adjusted Gross Income in Section 36B of the Internal Revenue Code is included in the MAGI calculation for SoonerCare eligibility
Gross income does not include the value of property acquired by gift, bequest, devise, or inheritance.
